description: Crawl preflight: whether each user agent may fetch each URL under the site's robots.txt (RFC 9309, longest match, '*' fallback), with crawl-delay, the sitemaps robots.txt lists and whether the site publishes /llms.txt. Default agents: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Googlebot, Bingbot, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider and *. Paid only: up to 5 URLs per call for $0.001 USDC. Paid calls made without a payment return isError with the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object (amount in USDC atomic units, network, payTo, HTTP endpoint); retry with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Invalid input and calls where every item fails are never charged. Fetches follow robots.txt, use the User-Agent AdamHaleTools/1.0 and refuse private or internal addresses.

items.description: A public http(s) URL or bare domain (bare domain = its https:// homepage). No IP addresses, internal names or ports other than 80/443.

x402_payment.description: Optional, paid tier only: a signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload, base64 (the value an HTTP client sends as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Prefer params._meta["x402/payment"]. Never a private key or seed phrase.
